verdict.rationale: Sprinto has a dedicated Vendors section in its data library, with documented Vendor Risk Assessment and security questionnaire workflows, plus Vendor Data APIs. The AI Systems module adds vendor due diligence covering security posture, document requests, request tracking and questionnaires, so vendor inventory and risk review happen in-platform rather than in a spreadsheet. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of tracking vendor data access, configurable periodic review cadence or reminders for general vendors, substantive doc content beyond page titles for the core vendor module, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
